evidenceDefinitions.cross_process_data: Actual separate receiving process reads production native pasteboard representations and bytes. This is distinct from physical drag acceptance and a sandboxed target application.
evidenceDefinitions.native_controls: Own-process real native/SwiftUI controls, supported AX actions, menu selection or native text editing. Some suites also contain direct setup/state calls; mapping does not mean all their assertions are physical actions.
evidenceDefinitions.physical_os_boundary: Explicit unsupported/unexecuted boundary. Native permission/chooser/pointer/AVKit/VoiceOver/hardware gaps remain until independent actual evidence exists.
evidenceDefinitions.render_geometry: Native screenshots/pixel/geometry/layout/choreography/performance fixture evidence at explicitly tested sizes/states; not human-usability-study evidence.
evidenceDefinitions.state_service: Production state/store/service APIs with disposable archives, isolated preferences, private clipboard or fakes. Transaction/callback/command coverage, not continuous user walkthroughs.
